The machine-readable contract is [`/api/v1/openapi.json`](https://mapsurvey.org/api/v1/openapi.json)
(OpenAPI 3.1): load it into Postman, Insomnia or a client generator. This page is generated from it.
To make your first call, see [Use the REST API](/how-to/use-the-rest-api/).

**Base URL** `https://mapsurvey.org/api/v1` · **Authentication** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` —
a [personal token](/how-to/personal-tokens/) or an OAuth 2.1 access token · **Plan** the workspace
that owns the survey must be on [Pro](/reference/plans-and-billing/).

## Errors

Every error has the same shape: `{"error": "<code>", "detail": "<text>", ...}`. Switch on `error`;
`detail` is for people and may change. `validation` errors add `fields` (field name → messages),
and an unknown field in a request body is refused by name rather than ignored.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_token` | 401 | No bearer token, or one that is unknown, expired or revoked. |
| `scope_missing` | 403 | The token lacks the permission this call needs (`scope` names it). |
| `pro_required` | 403 | The survey's workspace is not on Pro (`upgrade_url` links to its billing page). |
| `forbidden_role` | 403 | You can see the survey but your role on it is too low (`role` names the one needed). |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing there — or nothing you may see. The two are deliberately the same answer. |
| `validation` | 422 | The body or a parameter is invalid; `fields` lists what and why. |
| `draft_required` | 409 | A structural change to a live survey: start unpublished changes (`draft` is their uuid when they exist). |
| `answers_at_risk` | 409 | The delete would remove `count` answers; repeat with `acknowledge_answer_loss=true`. |
| `delete_blocked` | 409 | Something else depends on what you are deleting. |
| `translation_gaps` | 409 | Some languages are missing text; repeat with `acknowledge_translation_gaps: true`. |
| `incompatible_draft` | 409 | Unpublished changes conflict with collected answers; repeat with `force: true`. |
| `transition_refused` | 409 | The survey cannot move to that status from where it is. |
| `email_unconfirmed` | 403 | The account has not confirmed its email address yet; publishing waits for it. |
| `conflict` | 409 | The request conflicts with the current state (e.g. unpublished changes already exist). |
| `bad_cursor` | 400 | The pagination cursor is not valid for this list. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | That HTTP method is not offered on this path (`Allow` lists the ones that are). |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many calls; wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `server_error` | 500 | Our fault. It is logged; retrying later is safe for reads. |

### `PATCH /surveys/{uuid}`

Settings, the thanks page and the map start. Settings and the map need
the owner role, like the editor; the thanks page the editor role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null |  |  |
| `redirect_url` | string or null |  | "#" for the built-in thanks page, or an absolute http(s) URL. |
| `languages` | list of string or null |  |  |
| `visibility` | `public` | `private` | `demo` or null |  |  |
| `basemaps` | list of string or null |  | Preset keys (streets, satellite, topo, paper, paper_b) or "style:<uuid>" of a workspace map style; a key the workspace does not have is dropped. |
| `default_basemap` | string or null |  | One of `basemaps`; else the first enabled key. |
| `show_branding` | boolean or null |  |  |
| `thanks_html` | object or null |  | Thanks page per language; creator HTML, sanitised on save. |
| `map_start` | MapStart or null |  |  |
| `use_geolocation` | boolean or null |  |  |
| `opens_at` | date-time or null |  | Start of the survey period: ISO 8601 with an offset, or a naive value read in schedule_timezone. Null clears it. |
| `closes_at` | date-time or null |  | End of the survey period, after the start and in the future. Null clears it. Reopening a survey by hand clears a past end. |
| `schedule_timezone` | string or null |  | IANA zone (e.g. "Europe/Berlin") naive period values are read in and times are shown in; "" = UTC. |

**200** SurveyDetailOut

Errors: `draft_required`, `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `POST /surveys/{uuid}/questions/{question_id}/move`

Move a question to another section, into a pop-up or out of one, to `position`.

Between sections it keeps its answers and leaves its group. Into or out of a
pop-up its answers cannot follow (one per respondent against one per mark):
`409 answers_at_risk` until `acknowledge_answer_loss`. Rules the move breaks
are cleared and named in `removed_rules`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |
| `question_id` | path | integer | yes |

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `section_id` | integer or null |  | Target section of the same survey; default: its own. |
| `parent_id` | integer or null |  | Move into this question's pop-up; null moves it to the section's top level. |
| `position` | integer or null |  | Place among the target list's items (a group counts as one); default: the end. |
| `acknowledge_answer_loss` | boolean |  |  |

**200** MoveOut

Errors: `answers_at_risk`, `draft_required`, `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

| `limit` | query | integer |  |

**200** list of IconOut

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `DELETE /reports/{uuid}/blocks/{block_id}`

Remove a block from the report.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |
| `block_id` | path | integer | yes |

**200** object

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`
